name: leadership
desc: For 1 minute, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 ft. of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is incapacitated.
